description: Get messages from a WhatsApp group conversation, newest first, with the sender of each message. Read-only: reading a group NEVER marks its messages as read and sends no read receipts. Use get_groups to list groups and their ids.

group_id.description: The group to read. Accepts the group chat_id (e.g. 120363041234567890@g.us), the id returned by get_groups, or the group name.

name: get_group_messages
